component.name: Luair
component.summary: Independent desktop crosshair overlay powered by Rust and Tauri v2

description.p: Luair is a lightweight, open-source desktop crosshair overlay built with Rust and Tauri v2. It displays a transparent, click-through crosshair canvas over games with zero process injection, zero memory reading, and zero external accounts.

ul.li: Crosshair X-class vector/canvas customizer with dynamic firing spread and recoil colors
10 quick-switch slots with non-blocking global keyboard and mouse hotkeys
Liquid Glass and Solid Minimalist dynamic theme engine
Encrypted local-only account vault backed by SQLite, Argon2id, and AES-256-GCM
Embedded Candle local GGUF AI assistant and prompt-to-design generator

description.p: Fix Windows 10 overlay transparency, reliable F10 menu toggle, Windows ICO icon frames, and frameless launcher edge artifacts.
Align WebView2 additionalBrowserArgs across dual overlay and menu windows.
Initial Luair v2 Rust + Tauri release across Windows, Linux, and macOS Universal.
